issue.title: [Yang] BGP monitor name does not match yang definition

failure.body:
**Description**

BGP monitor name is bgp_monitor in test code, but it must be BGPMonitor in yang model.

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/tests/bgp/bgp_helpers.py#L31
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/master/src/sonic-yang-models/yang-models/sonic-bgp-monitor.yang#L45

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Run bgp/test_traffic_shift.py
2. Check bgp monitor name

**Describe the results you received:**
BGP monitor name is bgp_monitor

**Describe the results you expected:**
BGP monitor name should be BGPMonitor

**Additional information you deem important:**

    **Output of `show version`:**

    ```
    (paste your output here)
    ```

    **Attach debug file `sudo generate_dump`:**

    ```
    (paste your output here)
    ```

resolution.title: Change BGP_MONITOR_NAME to BGPMonitor to match name in yang model
